Hi Pavel! Yes, for split_meeting: the working time (session length minus breaks) should be divided as evenly as possible over the blocks. If it doesn't divide exactly, earlier blocks get one extra minute. E.g., 200 mins with max_block=90 becomes 67 + 67 + 66.

They're in my handover notes at notes/malte/handover.md. Key decision: in 'nearest' mode, a value exactly halfway between two grid points goes to the EARLIER point. E.g. align_to_grid(645, 30) == 630 and align_to_grid(615, 30) == 600. Rounding never pushes a meeting later.
